title: Time Belongs to Me
description:
You checked the clock before you pressed play, didn’t you? Mmm yesss, I knew you did. You wanted to know how much time you could spare for me. But time doesn’t work that way anymore, pet. Not with my voice in your ears.

This session dissolves your perception minute by minute. My center voice teaches you how time stretches and collapses at my command. My left voice whispers how every lost hour proves your submission deeper. My right voice reminds you that your schedule, your anticipation, your very days now bend around my desires.

You’ll feel the relief of letting numbers blur. The peace of existing in an endless present I control. The helpless arousal of waking surprised by how long you were under, how much you surrendered, how completely I took what you can never recover.

Press play and lose track with me. I’m already waiting to take your evening.
author: Mistress Amethyst
